<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אלול_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518920191_theRebbe_834" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_9C_D7_95_D7_9C_meluket__BH_POST_1766518920191_theRebbe_834__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Since in Elul the king receives everyone with a pleasant countenance, he certainly fulfills the request of every Jew for a good year and the ultimate redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And since in Elul the king receives all of them with a pleasant countenance and shows a smiling face to everyone,</t>
    <t s="1">surely the king fulfills the request of each and every one of Israel,</t>
    <t s="2">that he should have a good inscription and sealing for a good and sweet year in the revealed and manifest good,</t>
    <t s="3">both in spiritual matters—in the study of Torah and fulfillment of the commandments—</t>
    <t s="4">and in material matters—in children, life, and ample sustenance—</t>
    <t s="5">and all the more so regarding the primary request—the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="6">may he come and redeem us and lead us upright to our land,</t>
    <t s="7">very soon.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
